descriptionByLocale.it: Descrizione Technical Service Specialist (TSS), SPO BNA - Bobst North America Apply now Bobst North America è l'unico distributore per Bobst Group SA, produttore di apparecchiature di conversione per l'industria della stampa e dell'imballaggio. Gli obiettivi di questa posizione sono garantire che tutte le attività di assistenza tecnica, supporto e coordinamento della linea di prodotti Bobst SPO siano eseguite in modo tale da garantire il massimo livello di soddisfazione del cliente. Inoltre, l'operatore storico garantirà che forniamo assistenza sul campo ai clienti di livello mondiale per la linea di prodotti Bobst SPO, riflettendo le esigenze dei clienti e utilizzando tutte le risorse disponibili. Specialista dell'assistenza tecnica: lo specialista tecnico è un esperto di tutti gli aspetti delle apparecchiature Bobst SPO. Questo ruolo fornisce supporto tecnico alle vendite, ai clienti, al centro di assistenza e ai tecnici dell'assistenza sul campo. L'aspettativa funzionale chiave è la ricerca e la comunicazione di informazioni tecniche e l'aggiornamento delle attività in Salesforce e SAP. Questa pratica garantisce che le informazioni più accurate sullo stato del cliente siano disponibili in tempo reale. Lo Specialista Tecnico lavora a stretto contatto con il suo supervisore, i colleghi e i clienti interni per garantire un costante e accurato scambio di informazioni tecniche. L'obiettivo finale è garantire che le esigenze e le aspettative del cliente siano soddisfatte, sulla base delle aspettative del cliente e degli obiettivi di servizio interni. Ci si aspetta che il TSS dia l'esempio e - Fornire supporto tecnico e informazioni per le apparecchiature di nuova installazione. - Servire come o lavorare con il responsabile dell'installazione designato per le nuove installazioni di apparecchiature. - Seguire tutte le procedure approvate per i test di accettazione. - Sviluppare e coordinare iniziative PIP per la base installata di macchine. - Supportare le iniziative e i programmi di formazione - Stabilire ed eseguire la formazione dei clienti sul campo di volta in volta quando richiesto. - I programmi dovrebbero includere anche vendite interne, RSM e programmi di formazione per l'assistenza sul campo. - Supportare il reparto ricambi - Fornire assistenza per identificare parti difficili o assemblaggi di parti. - Convalidare parti e assiemi in base all'attrezzatura specifica e al numero di serie del produttore della macchina. - Gestione della garanzia della macchina - Assicurarsi che la procedura di garanzia sia correttamente applicata e che i costi siano gestiti in conformità con le linee guida del Gruppo. - Seguire le linee guida per le ispezioni delle parti restituite per confermare la conformità del cliente come richiesto. - Partecipare a fiere, esposizioni aziendali e altri eventi del settore secondo necessità. - Assumere un ruolo attivo nella ricerca della concorrenza e nello sviluppo della conoscenza del mercato di clienti, fornitori periferici e fornitori chiave. Attività giornaliere chiave - Rispondere alle richieste in arrivo di supporto tecnico da parte di clienti interni ed esterni. - Comunicare con il PL per risolvere i problemi aperti nell'elenco Questioni in sospeso - Quando richiesto, fornire input sul tecnico dell'assistenza sul campo più adatto per una visita di assistenza. - Comunicare
descriptionByLocale.en:
Technical Service Specialist (TSS), SPO BNA - Bobst North America Apply now Bobst North America is the sole distributor for Bobst Group SA, manufacturer of Converting Equipment for the Printing and Packaging industry. The objectives of this position are to ensure that all technical service, support and coordinating activities of the Bobst SPO product line are executed in such a way as to ensure the highest level of customer satisfaction. In addition, the incumbent will ensure that we provide world class Customer field service support for the Bobst SPO product line, reflecting the requirements of the Customers and utilizing all the resources available. Technical Service Specialist : The Technical Specialist is an expert on all aspects of Bobst SPO equipment. This role provides technical support to sales, customers, Service Center and Field Service Technicians. The key functional expectation is the research and communication of technical information and updating activities in the Salesforce and SAP. This practice ensures that the most accurate information on customer status is available on a real time basis. The Technical Specialist works closely with his supervisor, colleagues and internal customers to ensure a constant and accurate exchange of technical information. The ultimate goal is to ensure that customer needs and expectations are met, based on the customer’s expectations and the internal service objectives. The TSS is expected to lead by example and to build excitement and enthusiasm within the Service Team. He/she is a team player and takes responsibility for providing excellent customer service. The TSS is flexible with the customer and balances patience and professionalism while driving for solutions with demonstrated urgency. The ability to follow-up on all activities and projects, particularly coordinating date changes with all internal and external customers, is a key expectation of this role. The TSS performs this role with confidence, enthusiasm, and the desire to serve both internal and external customers. The TSS has effective communication, problem solving and follow-up skills. A key expectation of this role is ensuring that the team works together proactively to develop knowledge management solutions that reference and document information on behalf of customers, in addition to Salesforce and SAP. TSS keeps his cool under pressure and works with other team members and throughout the company to negotiate win-win solutions that serve the customer and the needs of the business. The TSS takes responsibility for helping the customer, even outside of his core area of competence, by directing the caller to the appropriate department, ensuring the customer is called back in a timely manner and/or confirming coordination and resolution between other departments. The role requires limited travel within the markets to visit customers to understand their needs and expectations. Representing the company is expected. This is a full-time position with the typical work week being Monday-Friday and may include occasional travel. The TSS works closely with the sales, service center and Regional Service Managers throughout North America. Main 
• Responsibilities: 1. Ensure customer satisfaction Review and analyze job layouts and samples for the existing customers. Investigate and/or support others regarding performance problems with new or existing applications. Provide “after hours” customer phone support as requested. 2. Support the sales team and RSMs through customer visits Clarify trip objectives and create an Absence Form to ensure prompt communication with supervisor. This assists in alerting all internal customers, eliminating duplication of effort, ensuring that there is adequate phone coverage and provides information to others about the status of a customer need. The TSS is expected to follow-up on customer commitments, provide a Trip Report to the supervisor, by the next business day, and follow up on commitments through coordination with internal customers. The TSS is responsible for ensuring that the office workload is managed appropriately and, if slippage occurs, communicates with supervisor to agree on prioritization of effort. 3. Support Field Service Technicians Communicate with respect and patience. Coach, mentor and train field service technicians in the diagnosis, repair, and performance of Bobst equipment. Display sensitivity to technicians, particularly when they are in the presence of the customer. Provide information to Field Service technicians to ensure that they are correctly informed prior to any critical intervention and to ensure that technical support is available as required. Provide feedback to management on technician performance and areas for improvement. Utilize the applicable skills database to deploy local, capable technicians for the specific job as well as technicians whose growth plan includes more exposure to particular kinds of machine interventions and/or training. 4. Support Regional Service Managers Provide technical support and information for newly installed equipment. Serve as or work with the designated Installation Leader for new equipment installations. Follow all approved procedures for Acceptance Tests. Develop and coordinate PIP initiatives for the installed base of machines. 5. Support the Training Initiatives and Programs Establish and perform customer training in the field from time to time when requested. Programs should also include internal sales, RSM and field service training programs. 6. Support the Parts Department Provide assistance to identify difficult parts or part assemblies. Validate parts and assemblies based on specific equipment and machine manufacturer serial number. 7. Machine Warranty Management Ensure that the warranty procedure is correctly applied and that costs are managed to be in compliance with Group guidelines. More specifically, follow guidelines for returned parts inspections to confirm customer compliance as requested. 8. Participate in trade shows, company expositions and other industry events as needed. Take an active role in researching the competition as well as developing market knowledge of customers, peripheral vendors and key suppliers. Key Daily Tasks: Respond to incoming requests for technical support from internal and external customers. Communicate with the PL to resolve open issues on the Pending Matters list When asked, provide input on the field service technician best suited for a service visit. Communicate regularly with the Technical Service Manager and Product Line Managers. Identify opportunities to solve customer problems by recommending spare parts, field repair Perform related duties as assigned or required to meet company goals and objectives. Maintain skill level information, validate with colleagues as necessary Contact existing customers on a regular basis, through visits or telephone contact, within the objectives set and with regard to ongoing projects.

descriptionByLocale.fr: Descrizione Technical Service Specialist (TSS), SPO BNA - Bobst North America Postulez maintenant Bobst North America est le seul distributeur de Bobst Group SA, fabricant d'équipements de conversion pour l'industrie de l'impression et de l'emballage. Les objectifs de ce poste sont de s'assurer que toutes les activités de service technique, de soutien et de coordination de la gamme de produits Bobst SPO sont exécutées de manière à assurer le plus haut niveau de satisfaction de la clientèle. En outre, le titulaire veillera à ce que nous fournissions un support de service client de classe mondiale pour la gamme de produits Bobst SPO, reflétant les exigences des clients et utilisant toutes les ressources disponibles. Spécialiste du service technique : Le spécialiste technique est un expert sur tous les aspects de l'équipement Bobst SPO. Ce rôle fournit un soutien technique aux ventes, aux clients, au centre de service et aux techniciens de service sur le terrain. L'attente fonctionnelle clé est la recherche et la communication d'informations techniques et les activités de mise à jour dans Salesforce et SAP. Cette pratique garantit que les informations les plus précises sur le statut du client sont disponibles en temps réel. Le Spécialiste Technique travaille en étroite collaboration avec son superviseur, ses collègues et ses clients internes pour assurer un échange constant et précis d'informations techniques. Le but ultime est de s'assurer que les besoins et les attentes des clients sont satisfaits, en fonction des attentes du client et des objectifs de service internes. On s'attend à ce que le TSS donne l'exemple et - Fournir un support technique et des informations pour les équipements nouvellement installés. - Servir ou travailler avec le responsable d'installation désigné pour les nouvelles installations d'équipement. - Suivre toutes les procédures approuvées pour les tests d'acceptation. - Développer et coordonner les initiatives PIP pour la base installée de machines. - Soutenir les initiatives et les programmes de formation - Mettre en place et effectuer des formations clients sur le terrain de temps à autre sur demande. - Les programmes doivent également inclure des programmes de formation aux ventes internes, à la GRS et au service sur le terrain. - Soutenir le service des pièces - Fournir une assistance pour identifier les pièces difficiles ou les assemblages de pièces. - Valider les pièces et les assemblages en fonction du numéro de série du fabricant de l'équipement et de la machine. - Gestion de la garantie des machines - S'assurer que la procédure de garantie est correctement appliquée et que les coûts sont gérés conformément aux directives du Groupe. - Suivez les directives pour les inspections des pièces retournées afin de confirmer la conformité du client comme demandé. - Participer à des salons professionnels, des expositions d'entreprise et d'autres événements de l'industrie au besoin. - Jouer un rôle actif dans la recherche de la concurrence ainsi que dans le développement de la connaissance du marché des clients, des fournisseurs périphériques et des fournisseurs clés. Tâches quotidiennes clés - Répondre aux demandes entrantes d'assistance technique des clients internes et externes. - Communiquer avec le PL pour résoudre les problèmes en suspens sur la liste des questions en suspens - Lorsque demandé, fournir des commentaires sur le technicien de service sur le terrain le mieux adapté pour une visite de service. - Communiquer
